title: WF03 OBS-04 deterministic auth harness: Playwright E2E now authenticates and reaches timeline assertions
summary: OBS-04 Playwright E2E previously failed at login due to runtime-dependent auth prerequisites. A deterministic in-test API harness now provides stable auth and instance/timeline responses, allowing assertions to execute reliably.

root_cause.details: The E2E relied on a runtime auth backend state that was not guaranteed in local/CI contexts, causing auth failure before timeline assertions.

changes: Added deterministic Playwright route handlers for /api/v1/auth/login, /api/v1/auth/me, /api/v1/instances, and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline.
Kept credential contract explicit via BPM_E2E_EMAIL/BPM_E2E_PASSWORD defaults while making login outcome deterministic.
Verified OBS-04 test executes and passes without skip/auth blocker.

prevention: For MUST-path browser E2E, provide deterministic auth/data fixtures in the test harness when runtime prerequisites are not guaranteed.
Do not leave OBS-04-like browser tests dependent on external credential seeding without an automated fallback path.
